title: Furniture Company Equity Stake For Sale in Érd, Hungary
tagline: Based in Érd, we're a go-to manufacturing partner for top global luxury brands, specializing in high-quality POS products and furniture for retail and hospitality. - Our team of around 30 skilled employees excels in engineering, project management, manufacturing, and logistics—making us a solid choice for any project. - We operate on a project-based revenue model, where we earn money through custom manufacturing, engineering, and hands-on implementation for premium brands. - We’ve seen impressive growth in our international business, with our export revenue tripling lately. - Our clients range from big-name international brands to local designers, especially in Central Europe. We're trusted for high-end projects in retail and corporate spaces. - High revenue is driven by high-value customized projects for global luxury brands, repeat contracts, and integrated in-house manufacturing capabilities. - Our in-house capabilities allow us to handle everything—from CNC production and complex material manufacturing to technical development—all tailored to fit project needs. - As a founder-led business, we're passionate about what we do, combining years of industry experience with a strong focus on quality and client satisfaction. - We deliver projects across Europe and have completed over 40 premium projects a year, many of which have won prestigious awards, showcasing our commitment to excellence. - We operate with a valid business license. All the land and the building documents are in place.
